# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.93

This release gives Buddy Rush clubs proper deterministic sites across the
infinite town, improves their visual identity, and adds shared collision for
world modules and characters.

## World layout and visuals

- Kept the player's central clubhouse anchored at its existing position.
- Moved Moonlight Club, Builder Base, and Pop Party House onto three widely
  separated, road-served parcels in different districts.
- Reserved every club footprint in the procedural tile plan for all seeds so
  roads, parks, and generated buildings cannot overlap a clubhouse.
- Replaced the oversized circular club pads with compact rectangular lots,
  clear entrances, and distinct observatory, workshop, and party-house designs.
- Rebuilt the Buddy Bus stop as a compact shelter with a canopy, transparent
  panels, bench, route sign, waiting pad, and its own reserved transit site.
- Registered the clubs and bus stop on the shared world tile/object map.

## Collision and navigation

- Added reusable compound collision modules for buildings, props, activity
  stations, and people.
- Connected Buddy Rush structures to player and vehicle collision.
- Added character-to-character collision for town NPCs, saved characters, and
  local multiplayer visitors.
- Updated NPC movement to avoid authored structures, club modules, the local
  player, and other characters.
- Kept collision performance predictable with small compound box proxies
  matched to visible modules rather than expensive triangle-mesh physics.

## Regression coverage

- Added deterministic multi-seed site, road-clearance, route, world-map,
  modular-collision, and NPC-obstacle tests.
- Added mobile end-to-end views for all three rival clubs and the Buddy Bus
  stop.
- Made mini-game reward assertions balance-relative and hardened the shared
  world-interaction harness against the welcome overlay.

## Android updates

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Retains the exact v1.5.79 update-signing identity so existing installations
  can update normally.
